finding: Root cause of Candidate Package 110 AM-PDAS force drop definitively diagnosed as EXTERNAL_QP_UEL_INCONSISTENCY: driver_c4_am_continuation.py hardcoded regularisation length E_L0 = 0.015 mm (15 um) instead of the strictly required 0.0075 mm (7.5 um) specified in the UEL property card (*UEL PROPERTY, 0.0075, 0.0027, 210.0, 0.3, 1.0E-07). This factor-of-2 discrepancy doubled the phase stiffness matrix diagonal (mean ratio 1.9908), causing the external QP solver to solve an artificially widened crack functional that diffused damage into the specimen bulk (Delta d ~ +0.14 across 4,585 nodes) and softened elastic modulus (1-d)^2 by 34%, dropping reaction force by 28%. When repaired to E_L0 = 0.0075 mm and augmented with trust-region damping (Delta d <= 0.05), Kdd matches UEL-consistent reference assembly to machine precision (< 1.3e-17), Cycle 1 RF2 = 180.03 N (+1.01%), Cycle 2 RF2 = 178.06 N (-0.10%), and Cycle 3 RF2 = 177.04 N (-0.67%), fully satisfying Gate C1-1 force continuity.
